Dangerous Love of the Two Ninjas! (Japanese: 二人の忍者 危険な恋！ The Dangerous Love of the Two Ninjas!) is the forty-seventh chapter of the Magical Pokémon Journey manga.

==Plot==
 
While working at his parents' bakery, Walnut meets the girl of his dreams -- Apricot, but he doesn't know it!
